test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 17 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Two pipes A and B can fill a cistern in 21 minutes and 28 minutes, respectively. Both the pipes are opened together but after 4 minutes, pipe B is turned off. What is the total time taken to fill the tank?
solution:
Given: Pipe A alone can fill the tank in 21 minutes and Pipe B in 28 minutes.

The formula used: 

Tank capacity = time taken × efficiency

Calculations:-

Let the capacity of the tank be LCM(21, 28)

Capacity of tank = 84 unit

By using the formula,

The efficiency of Pipe A = frac{{Tank capacity}}{{Time Taken}} = (84)/(21) = 4

Efficiency of Pipe B = frac{{Tank capacity}}{{Time Taken}} = (84)/(28) = 3 

Let the time taken by Pipe A to fill the remaining tank be t,

Tank filled by both for 4 minutes + tank filled by A for t minutes = 84 units

⇒ (3 + 4) × 4 + t × 4 = 84

⇒ 7 × 4 + 4t = 84

⇒ 4t = 84 - 28 = 56 

⇒ t = 14

⇒ Total time = 14 + 4 =18

.·. The time taken by Pipe A to fill the tank is 18 minutes.
